.....RESPONDENTS (BY SHRI A.P.S. TOMAR - PUBLIC PROSECUTOR)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the court passed the following:
 ORDER Case diary is available.

This is first application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C for grant of bail to the applicant as he has been arrested on 27.4.2023 in connection with Crime No.144/2023 registered at Police Station Dharnavada, District Guna for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(N) of IPC Aman Kushwah vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/17543310/
1 and under Section 5/6 of the POCSO Act.
Prosecution story, in brief is that the applicant kidnapped/abducted minor prosecutrix aged about 17 years and committed rape upon her.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the prosecutrix was major at the time of incident and she in her statement recorded during investigation under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. specifically stated that she herself called the applicant who eloped her at her aunt's house and did not commit any wrong with her.

entities.text: Aman Kushwah vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: No offence is made out against the applicant.
Trial will take time to conclude and therefore, in the aforesaid circumstances, applicant is entitled for grant of bail.

Learned counsel for the respondent/State has vehemently opposed the prayer and submits that the the prosecutrix was minor at the time of incident, therefore, the applicant is not entitled to be enlarged on bail.
Heard the learned counsel for both the parties.

Having considered rival submission, statement of the prosecutrix recorded during investigation under Section 164 of Cr.P.C., material produced on record with regard to her age and over all facts and circumstances, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this Court is of the view that the applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail,
hence the application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant be released on bail upon his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Court for his appearance before the Trial Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the Trial Court during the pendency of trial.

It is further directed that applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437 (3) of Cr.P.C.
This application is allowed and stands disposed of.
Certified copy, as per Rules.

(SATYENDRA KUMAR SINGH) JUDGE (alok) ALOK KUMAR 2023.06.19 17:21:35 +05'30'
